about: K.P.R. Mill Limited operates as an integrated apparel manufacturing company in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Textile, Sugar, and Others. The company offers textile products, such as compact, cotton combed, carded, polyester cotton, viscose, grindel yarn, red label yarn, colour melange, slub yarn, cotton, poly cotton, melange, BCI, organic, and CMIA REEL yarns; knitted cotton fabrics and readymade knitted apparel; and readymade garments comprising casual, sports,
